sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Crestmont Capital has lent over $2 billion to over 5,000 businesses and offers customized financing solutions including equipment financing, small business loans, and commercial financing.

Industry: Financial Services · HQ: Irvine, CA, United States · Size: <$50M · Products: Equipment Financing, Equipment Leasing, Equipment Lines of Credit, Vendor Financing, Commercial Financing, Capital Equipment Financing

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Crestmont Capital scores 7 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: No close match to a reference account. This lead stands on its own ICP fit rather than on resemblance to a known win.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
